events.title: v0.518 Release - Painter's Tape, Object Focus, Real-Time Sun
events.summary: v0.518 is pretty packed with updates!Focus mode - press Q while looking at a shape, and that shape will be the only thing you can paint until you press Q again to exit focus mode. Makes for quick work of painting objects without worrying about overspray!Painter's tape - press Shift + 0 to use the Painter's Tape tool, which allows masking off areas with tape, then removing that tape later. events.title: v0.514 released with couch co-op mode up to 4 players!
events.summary: You can now connect game controllers and play split screen mode with up to 4 players. Any empty squares are used for a "sky cam" to watch overall progress from, or you can expand the player views instead. events.title: v0.504 Release!
events.summary: Paint The World — v0.504Catch-up notes covering everything since v0.499. NewAim Lock (middle-click) - paint with a perfectly still camera. Move the mouse to slide a reticle around the screen instead of turning the view. Ideal if first-person movement makes you queasy. Steam Deck touch painting (experimental) - touch the screen to paint right where you point, and look around with the stick. Join our Discord - a link right on the title screen. Come share what you've painted and ideas for the game!
